  • Definir a estratégia de ventilação da mina subterrânea, garantindo alinhamento ao plano de negócios, à segurança dos trabalhadores e à sustentabilidade da operação;

  • Propor e implementar inovações, melhorias tecnológicas e iniciativas de otimização de custos nos sistemas de ventilação, visando ganhos de produtividade, segurança e sustentabilidade;
  • Analisar riscos críticos relacionados à ventilação, gases, particulados e condições ambientais, apoiando a gestão de riscos operacionais e a tomada de decisão estratégica;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com geologia, planejamento de mina, produção, manutenção e SSMA;
  • Liderar estudos avançados de ventilação e projetos associados à expansão, aprofundamento ou mudanças de layout da mina, viabilizando tecnicamente novos cenários operacionais com segurança e eficiência.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação Completa em Engenharia;

  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Ventilação de Minas, Segurança do Trabalho (desejável).


Se você tem interesse em ventilação de mina subterrânea, planejamento e controle da qualidade do ar, atuação em campo e liderança de equipes em um ambiente operacional dinâmico, essa vaga pode ser para você!

title: Veterinarian
description:
About SignalPET


SignalPET is a fast-growing veterinary AI company working alongside veterinarians and radiologists to deliver faster, more accurate diagnostic support. Our mission is to enhance clinical decision-making through intelligent technology grounded in real-world veterinary medicine.


We are expanding our Medical R&D team in Brazil and are looking for a clinically strong, detail-oriented veterinarian to help build and refine the medical intelligence powering our platform.


The Role


As a Veterinarian – Medical Education & Medical Content , you will transform real SignalPET clinical cases into structured educational modules and high-quality medical marketing content.


You will help build and execute the SignalPET Training Hub & Academy , including CE-accredited learning modules, case-based training, and medical campaigns that strengthen veterinarians’ radiology skills and reinforce SignalPET’s clinical authority.


This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional role working closely with:


  • Board-certified radiologists
  • Medical R&D
  • AI and Product teams
  • Marketing


Key Responsibilities


Academy & CE Content Development


  • Develop structured, case-based learning modules using real SignalPET cases
  • Create CE-accredited courses, micro-learning sessions, pathology refreshers, and interactive quizzes
  • Build AI vs. Radiologist comparison educational insights
  • Work with specialists to validate medical accuracy
  • Manage and publish modules inside the Training Hub platform


Medical Marketing Content


  • Write clinically authoritative blogs, case spotlights, white papers, landing page content, and educational campaigns
  • Develop product-related medical materials and sales enablement tools
  • Collaborate with marketing to align messaging and positioning
  • Ensure scientific credibility through specialist validation


Workflow-Connected Learning


  • Map common clinical findings (e.g., splenic masses, thoracic disease, trauma cases) to relevant Academy modules
  • Collaborate with AI and Product teams to connect case workflows with learning opportunities


Performance & Optimization


  • Define and track CE engagement, learning participation, and content performance metrics
  • Continuously refine modules based on user feedback and clinical data


Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Participate in relevant internal meetings
  • Provide medical clarification for marketing and product initiatives
  • Coordinate with specialists and Medical R&D for content validation


Requirements


  • Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) or equivalent
  • Clinical Experience - Hands-on experience in small animal practice
  • Strong radiographic interpretation skills (canine & feline)
  • Radiology-focused experience is a plus
  • Excellent English writing skills (medical & educational content)
  • Ability to translate complex medical topics into clear, structured content
  • Experience creating CE-accredited content is a strong advantage
  • Strong small animal radiology knowledge
  • Ability to collaborate with board-certified specialists
  • Understanding of adult learning principles
  • Comfortable working in CMS and digital platforms


Working Hours


  • Monday to Friday - 7am to 4pm

This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews.


Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.


We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.



Why Join SignalPET?


  • Work at the intersection of veterinary medicine and AI
  • Impact thousands of veterinary professionals globally
  • Remote flexibility
  • Be part of a growing, mission-driven team

title: Content Analyst
description:
Career Opportunity: Content Analyst at Hartwell Companies


Hartwell Companies, a leader in industry innovation and a hub for top-tier talent, is on the lookout for an experienced Content Analyst to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity to make an impact in a dynamic, growth-oriented organization.


About Us: Hartwell Companies bring together strategically aligned businesses with a shared commitment to growth, innovation, and positive impact. We are a collective of dynamic enterprises, providing management experience, fresh insights, and resources to nurture each brand under our umbrella.


Position: Content Analyst

Location: Brazil

Work Model: Contractor Remote

Working Hours: 8 AM to 5 PM EST


Job Description:

The primary purpose of this role is to plan, coordinate, and execute the content strategy for Hartwell companies, including SONCO Safety Marketplace.

The Content Analyst will ensure all website content is SEO-driven and aligned with Information Architecture (IA) best practices to improve search rankings, organic traffic, and user experience.

This role includes creating product descriptions for new product pages, developing content for all website pages, social media, producing customer success cases, and building alliances with organizations, associations, and LinkedIn communities to generate co-marketing initiatives.


Main Responsibilities

  • Plan, create, and distribute valuable content.
  • Lead the development and optimization of website product pages, ensuring excellent user experience and strong SEO performance.
  • Ensure website content supports the SEO strategy, including keyword targeting, internal linking, and Information Architecture improvements to enhance rankings and crawlability.
  • Collaborate with design, video, and content writing teams to produce high-quality, SEO-driven content.
  • Plan and write customer success stories and blog posts for our website. Conduct customer interviews to gather accurate information and brief the copywriting team effectively.
  • Define and pursue alliances with organizations, associations, and LinkedIn communities for co-marketing initiatives.
  • Review and refine digital ad content to ensure consistency and performance alignment.
  • Develop attractive, original content to attract and retain users.
  • Distribute content across channels (website, social media, email, blog).
  • Own and optimize the customer review process.
  • Support the marketing team by conducting client surveys.
  • Measure, analyze, and present results of content strategy efforts, including SEO and organic performance metrics.


Skills and Competencies required:

  • Exceptional writing and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Advanced skill level in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with WordPress.
  • Knowledge of web publishing requirements and content structuring best practices.
  • Hands-on experience with SEO and web traffic metrics.
  • Understanding of Information Architecture (IA) principles and how content structure impacts SEO and user experience.
  • Strong familiarity with various social media platforms.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to use own initiative to progress work and to work to deadlines.
  • Flexible and creative attitude toward problem-solving.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues across business units.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory, with the ability to write and interact with the US-based team.


Other details of the position:

  • Contract type: Full-time consultant.
  • Working hours: 8 hours daily (from 8 am to 5 pm EST).

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) iOS para atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicativos mobile para o ecossistema Apple. Essa pessoa será responsável por construir novas funcionalidades, evoluir a arquitetura das aplicações e garantir qualidade, performance e escalabilidade do código .


Buscamos alguém com boa autonomia técnica, atenção à qualidade do código e que goste de colaborar com times multidisciplinares.

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicativos iOS utilizando Swift

  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de interfaces utilizando Auto Layout e Interface Builder (Storyboards e XIBs)

  • Familiaridade com design patterns como Delegate, Notification e Injeção de Dependências
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de dependências utilizando CocoaPods
  • Conhecimento dos frameworks nativos da Apple e das Human Interface Guidelines
  • Experiência no consumo de APIs RESTful e manipulação de JSON
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git (Gitflow)
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Experiência com publicação e gerenciamento de aplicativos na App Store
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de software mobile
  • Experiência com automação de testes para aplicações mobile
  • Experiência com Firebase
  • Experiência com integração com APIs e SDKs nativos do iOS

title: Gerente de Projetos de Infraestrutura e Segurança #992612
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Detalhes do Projeto

Consultor Funcional SAP MM com forte capacidade analítica e conhecimento de processos de suprimentos e gestão de materiais. Será responsável pelo mapeamento funcional de dados oriundos de transações Standard e Z (aproximadamente 70 transações), fornecendo direcionamento estruturado ao time ABAP para desenvolvimento de extratores e disponibilização das informações para fins analíticos e integrações.


Detalhes do projeto :

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Projetos Pleno com experiência em Infraestrutura de TI e Segurança da Informação, para atuar em regime 100% remoto. O(a) profissional será responsável pela governança de fornecedores, acompanhamento de projetos simultâneos e consolidação de relatórios estratégicos para a diretoria.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

- Elaboração de relatórios executivos que apontam vulnerabilidades identificadas em sistemas, aplicações, nuvem e desenvolvimentos internos.

- Análise de riscos de exposição e consolidação das falhas encontradas, destacando impacto e urgência.

- Acompanhamento das correções junto aos responsáveis pelas aplicações e infraestrutura, cobrando prazos e garantindo execução das ações necessárias.

- Governança de fornecedores: monitorar contratos, SLAs e reuniões periódicas para assegurar cumprimento das entregas.

- Apresentação quinzenal de reports para a diretoria, com status das vulnerabilidades, riscos e andamento das correções.

- Gestão de múltiplos projetos simultâneos (3 a 5 em média), equilibrando governança de segurança e infraestrutura.

- Suporte aos projetos conduzidos por terceiros, garantindo alinhamento com processos internos e prazos definidos.

- Controle financeiro e de terceiros envolvidos nos projetos, assegurando conformidade e eficiência.

- Aplicação de metodologias ágeis (SCRUM/PMI) para organizar e acompanhar atividades de segurança e infraestrutura.


Experiência :

- Experiência em gerenciamento de projetos de infraestrutura e segurança.

- Vivência em governança de fornecedores, contratos e acompanhamento de SLAs.

- Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (SCRUM, PMI).

- Experiência em elaboração de relatórios executivos sobre vulnerabilidades e riscos.

- Capacidade de acompanhar e cobrar correções de falhas em sistemas, aplicações e nuvem.

- Conhecimento técnico em ambientes de:

- Azure

- AWS

- Active Directory (AD)

- SIEM

- Firewall

- CNAP

- CSPM


Diferenciais

- Graduação ou experiência prévia em Segurança da Informação.

- Experiência em projetos de infraestrutura de TI voltados para segurança.

- Habilidade em comunicação assertiva

title: Designer instrucional
description:
Busca por Designer Instrucional Sênior


Estou buscando um Designer Instrucional Sênior para desenvolver uma capacitação para minha empresa.

Meu nome é Daniel Burd , sou CEO da Call Daniel , empresa especializada em treinamentos de produtividade para organizações .

Daniel Burd

title: Office of the CEO Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Office of the CEO Analyst position focuses on analyzing, defining, and continuously improving processes across the organization while working on high-impact initiatives directly sponsored by executive leadership. This role offers unique exposure to strategic priorities and cross-company operations, providing the opportunity to identify systemic issues, propose solutions, and drive measurable impact through process optimization and automation in a hyper-growth environment.


Key responsibilities


- Analyzing and defining processes, detecting systemic issues, and proposing solutions while leading or supporting the execution and implementation of improvements.

- Identifying automation and efficiency opportunities within executive administrative scope, documenting processes for scalability and long-term effectiveness.

- Filtering, classifying, and routing executive communications through appropriate channels, applying judgment and business context to prioritize matters requiring leadership attention.

- Serving as the primary point of contact for day-to-day executive communication and coordination.

- Supporting cross-functional initiatives that require executive sponsorship, helping translate strategic priorities into structured execution plans.


Requirements


- Process Experience: Demonstrated background working with processes and operations management.

- Methodical Approach: Strong organizational skills with a process-driven and detail-oriented mindset.

- Analytical Capabilities: Proven ability to analyze complex situations and identify improvement opportunities.

- Language Proficiency: Good level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor Salesforce - Sênior
description:
Sobre a vaga


Código da vaga: 57333


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Inglês avançado/fluente.
  • Desenvolvimento e customização de soluções na plataforma Salesforce (Salesforce CRM, Lightning, Apex, Visualforce, Aura e LWC), seguindo boas práticas de governança e arquitetura.
  • Atuação em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento: análise, implementação, testes, implantação, suporte e manutenção da instância Salesforce.
  • Codificação e integração utilizando Apex, SOQL, SOSL, APIs REST, além de ferramentas como Data Loader, Postman e recursos OOB do Salesforce.
  • Conhecimento sólido em tecnologias web (JavaScript, HTML5, CSS) e uso de controle de versionamento (Git/Bitbucket).
  • Colaboração com usuários-chave, arquitetos e consultores de negócio, realizando demonstrações e garantindo aderência aos requisitos funcionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Elaboração de documentação técnica, protótipos, fluxogramas, diagramas de sequência e planos de testes, assegurando qualidade e conformidade das entregas.
  • Revisão de código e aplicação de padrões consolidados de desenvolvimento (OOP, MVC/MVCS, Domain Layer Principle).


Diferenciais:


  • Idioma espanhol; experiência com Commerce Cloud e Experience Cloud; certificações Salesforce (Platform Developer I, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer II, Administrator, JavaScript Developer I, Data Architect, Sharing and Visibility Architect).

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect


Location: Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .



What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .

title: Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript / GraphQL)

Location: Remote – Brazil or Mexico

Employment Type: Contract

Interview Process: Internal Interview + Client Interview


Role Details

We are looking for a talented senior data engineer specializing in building a highly scalable cloudbased GraphQL API layer to deliver sports and betting data across multiple digital platforms. This role involves creating a seamless and efficient data ingestion processing and delivery system integrating streaming data and highperformance querying.


You’ll work closely with crossfunctional teams to design and implement a federated GraphQL architecture driving the future of sports and betting data integration within the CBS Sports digital ecosystem.


Your Day-to-Day

  • Build new foundational capabilities using domain-driven design and test-driven development that will power features and experiences on various CBS Sports properties
  • Help lead team members in the design development and optimization of our core sports GraphQL subgraphs and services within a federated architecture
  • Participate in scrum ceremonies daily standups grooming and sprint planning
  • Practice DevOps writing good tests and deploying continuously to production with observability and monitoring
  • Review your teammates designs and code providing constructive feedback and engaging in technical discussions including weekly deep dive sessions on various topics
  • Work with product partners to develop technical solutions for features leveraging GraphQL for data integration


Key Projects

  • Building out a GraphQL API for seamless data access and integration across multiple services
  • Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products ingesting processing and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores
  • Defining a distributed tracing system for web services and data observability within a GraphQL ecosystem
  • Containerizing core systems to reduce the overhead of infrastructure management


Qualifications

What you bring to the team

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering and data system development
  • Experience in designing implementing and maintaining GraphQL schemas optimizing query performance and ensuring seamless data retrieval and manipulation for enhanced user experiences
  • Experience with Javascript TypeScript Python Nodejs
  • Experience with relational NoSQL and keyvalue data stores such as Aurora MySQL DynamoDB MongoDB Redis
  • Hands-on experience working in a distributed cloudbased environment AWS preferred with high transaction volumes using a variety of connected services
  • Proficiency with modern build strategies continuous integration unit testing and automated integration tests GitHub issue tracking tools Jira and CICD related disciplines GitOps
  • Ability to design solutions provide estimates and evaluate risk and technical feasibility
  • BS Computer Science Engineering a related technical degree or equivalent professional experience


You might also have

  • Wundergraph Cosmo or Apollo GraphQL experience
  • AWS Certifications
  • Experience with extract transform load ETL pipelines using data orchestration platforms cloud services and frameworks a plus
  • Experience at an online company in digital media or content creation
  • Excellent team player and communicator capable of creating positive relationships across engineering product and architecture
  • Energetic selfstarter who can work in a complex collaborative environment that rewards innovation initiative curiosity and mentoring
  • Knowledge of sports and gaming

title: Corporate Content Creator
description:
Company Overview:

Lean Tech is a fast-growing technology company based in Medellín, Colombia, with a strong network in software development and IT services across the entertainment, financial, and logistics industries. The company offers significant opportunities for professional growth while working with engineering teams across Latin America and the United States on innovative projects. Lean Tech is seeking a Mid-level Corporate Content Creator & Training Evangelist to design and deliver high-quality multimedia training materials that communicate company initiatives, operational standards, and internal programs. This role combines content creation, instructional design, and corporate communication to transform complex operational and technical topics into clear, engaging materials such as documents, presentations, videos, and visual assets. The position will work closely with Operations, Product, Technology, Compliance, and Business Application teams to identify knowledge gaps and develop scalable training programs that enhance employee performance and operational excellence.


Position title: Mid-level Corporate Content Creator

Location: Remote - LATAM


Key Responsibilities:

Content Creation & Corporate Communication

  • Develop high-quality written content including structured documentation, manuals, process guides, and corporate communications using tools such as Microsoft Word and Visio.
  • Produce professional video content, visual assets, and multimedia training materials that effectively communicate company processes, systems, and initiatives.
  • Create engaging PowerPoint presentations, PDF learning materials, and visual storytelling assets for internal education and corporate messaging.
  • Design and produce multimedia learning content including tutorials, explainer videos, diagrams, infographics, and process walkthroughs.
  • Ensure all content follows corporate communication standards, branding, and messaging consistency.


Training Program Design & Instructional Development

  • Design, develop, and implement training curriculums tailored to employee roles and operational requirements.
  • Build structured learning programs including:
  • Best practices
  • Work instructions
  • Process documentation
  • Continuous improvement initiatives
  • Maintain and facilitate training curriculum, demonstrations, documentation, and certification programs for employees across different operational areas.
  • Develop training programs for New Hire Onboarding and Continuous Development, including defined milestones and certification expectations.
  • Create training frameworks that support different learning styles and modern learning methods (visual, video-based, interactive).


Training Delivery & Evangelization

  • Act as a corporate evangelist for training initiatives, promoting adoption of best practices and operational standards across the company.
  • Facilitate training workshops, demos, and learning sessions for internal teams.
  • Drive adoption of training content and learning initiatives through clear communication and engaging delivery methods.


Training Strategy & Performance Monitoring

  • Define and analyze training effectiveness metrics, measuring performance, adoption, and knowledge retention.
  • Monitor training program outcomes to ensure alignment with company standards, compliance policies, and operational procedures.
  • Continuously improve training content based on data insights, feedback, and operational changes.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Business Application Owners, Operations Leadership, Product, Technology, and Compliance teams to identify training gaps and improvement opportunities.
  • Work with stakeholders across regions to ensure training programs reflect operational differences by region, station, carrier, mode of transport, or client requirements.
  • Collaborate with teams to ensure data quality, process improvements, and workflow alignment within training materials.

Process & Content Governance

  • Maintain structured documentation repositories and ensure training materials remain current and aligned with evolving company processes.
  • Support workflow optimization and documentation standardization across departments.
  • Contribute to training roadmaps and long-term learning strategies.

Required Skills & QualificationsProfessional Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in content creation, corporate training, instructional design, or learning and development roles.
  • Proven experience producing multimedia training materials including documentation, presentations, video, and visual content.
  • Experience designing corporate training programs and internal knowledge frameworks.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and global organizations.

Content & Media Creation Skills

  • Advanced expertise in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Visio or similar diagramming tools.
  • Experience creating professional training videos and visual content.
  • Strong understanding of instructional design and modern learning methodologies.
  • Ability to produce structured, well-written documentation with excellent editorial quality.
  • Experience with camtasia or other video and image editing.
  • Experience with Adobe reader or other tools to generate content

Communication Skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly.
  • Strong storytelling ability to transform technical information into engaging content.

Analytical & Organizational Skills

  • Strong research and analytical skills to identify training opportunities and learning gaps.
  • Ability to analyze training metrics and continuously improve programs.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational capabilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple content projects simultaneously.

Collaboration & Work Style

  • Strong collaboration skills across distributed and global teams.
  • Ability to work in ambiguous environments and deliver high-quality results with minimal supervision.
  • Empathy for end users to design intuitive and practical learning experiences.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in corporate training, knowledge management, or learning experience design.
  • Familiarity with learning management systems (LMS).
  • Experience in global operations environments such as logistics, transportation, or supply chain.
  • Knowledge of project management frameworks and backlog management tools.

Why you will love Lean Tech:

  • Join a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology
  • Professional development opportunities with international customers
  • Collaborative work environment
  • Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels.


Join Lean Tech and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect


Location: Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .



What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .

title: Mid Back-End Data Engineer (.Net / C#)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Mid Back-End Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience and strong expertise in .NET and C#. This role focuses on ingesting and transforming data from multiple sources, running data validations, and ensuring high data quality across ETL pipelines and backend services. The ideal candidate has experience with APIs, legacy data migrations, and AWS-based data environments. Experience with ECS Fargate, SQS, Kinesis, Firehose, S3, and Apache Iceberg is a plus.

This project has a 3-6 month duration with a possibility for long-term engagement.

Our client is a leading energy technology company focused on digitizing fuel operations through a single, real-time platform. Their software connects people, equipment, and facilities to provide enterprise-wide visibility and data-driven insights that fuel asset optimization, improve operational efficiency, and help organizations manage risk, maintenance, and fuel logistics more effectively.

Responsibilities


  • Receive and process raw data from multiple internal and legacy systems.
  • Design and implement data transformation pipelines that convert incoming data into standardized formats.
  • Develop and maintain .NET / C# services and APIs used for data ingestion and transformation.
  • Build and execute data validation and quality checks to ensure the reliability and accuracy of data pipelines.
  • Support ETL processes, including exporting data from legacy systems and integrating it into modern platforms.
  • Work closely with existing engineers responsible for data migration and integration efforts.
  • Act as a data quality advocate, focusing on validating and testing data flows rather than application UI or front-end functionality.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering and data teams to improve data consistency, validation processes, and pipeline stability.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering or data engineering roles.
  • Strong experience with .NET and C# development.
  • Experience developing APIs and backend services.
  • Hands-on experience with data pipelines, ETL processes, and data transformation.
  • Experience implementing data validation and data quality checks.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple systems or legacy platforms.
  • Familiarity with AWS-based data infrastructure and services.


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Python for data processing or scripting.
  • Experience working with Apache Iceberg tables for data lake management.
  • Experience with AWS data and streaming services, such as:
  • Amazon ECS Fargate
  • Amazon SQS
  • Amazon Kinesis
  • Amazon Kinesis Firehose
  • Amazon S3


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • Start: ASAP

Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. description:
Funcionário, Freelance, Contrato, Terceiro ou Temporário

Remoto, Híbrido ou Presencial

Mínimo 2 anos de experiência na área


Sobre a empresa

A COMTRAFO Indústria de Transformadores Elétricos S.A. é uma empresa brasileira especializada no projeto e fabricação de transformadores de potência para concessionárias e grandes projetos de energia no Brasil e no exterior.

A empresa integra o grupo American Superconductor Corporation (AMSC) , companhia global de tecnologia energética sediada nos Estados Unidos, ampliando sua atuação internacional e capacidade de inovação.

Esse momento de expansão cria oportunidades de desenvolvimento técnico, crescimento profissional e participação em projetos de engenharia de alta complexidade no setor elétrico . ⚡


Descrição da vaga

A COMTRAFO Indústria de Transformadores Elétricos S.A. , empresa do grupo American Superconductor Corporation (AMSC) , busca profissional para atuar como Projetista / Calculista Elétrico de Transformadores de Potência , integrando a área de Orçamentos e Engenharia de Vendas .

O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de estudos técnicos, dimensionamento e elaboração de propostas para transformadores de potência até 345 kV , destinados ao mercado nacional e internacional , atuando em interface com as áreas de engenharia, comercial e clientes.


Principais atividades:

  • Realizar dimensionamento de transformadores de potência (reatância, perdas, correntes, impedâncias, esforços de curto-circuito, etc.);
  • Elaborar memoriais de cálculo e folhas de dados técnicas para propostas;
  • Analisar especificações técnicas de clientes (ET / RFQ) e normas aplicáveis;
  • Definir configurações técnicas e construtivas dos equipamentos para atendimento às especificações;
  • Apoiar a área comercial na elaboração de propostas técnicas e comerciais ;
  • Interagir com clientes e equipes internas para esclarecimentos técnicos durante o processo de oferta ;
  • Participar da avaliação técnica de riscos e viabilidade de fornecimento .


Perfil desejado:

  • Formação em Engenharia Elétrica ;
  • Conhecimento em transformadores de potência e seus princípios de projeto ;
  • Familiaridade com normas técnicas do setor (IEC / IEEE) ;
  • Capacidade de análise técnica, organização e comunicação com diferentes áreas;
  • Inglês técnico será considerado diferencial.


O profissional terá a oportunidade de atuar em projetos de engenharia para sistemas elétricos de alta complexidade , contribuindo para soluções destinadas a utilities e grandes projetos de energia no Brasil e no exterior . ⚡

title: Virtual Assistant – Real Estate Operations & Executive Support
description:
Polaris Advisors is a high-performing real estate team at Compass , specializing in residential sales, investments, and advisory services in South Florida. Known for its strategic approach, strong operational structure, and client-focused execution, Polaris Advisors delivers a high-level experience across every stage of the real estate process.


We are seeking a high-performing Virtual Assistant based in Brazil to support our Real Estate Operations and Marketing team at a high-producing team at Compass . This is a remote position for candidates located in Brazil , compensated in Brazilian Reais (BRL) .


This role requires a professional who is highly organized, detail-oriented, tech-savvy , and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven U.S. real estate environment .


You will work closely with the Real Estate Operations Manager and the Principal of the team , supporting property listings, marketing initiatives, and operational workflows. This position is ideal for someone who takes ownership of their work, communicates clearly, and consistently delivers high-quality execution.


Training will be provided on MLS systems and the Compass platform , and the ideal candidate must demonstrate a strong ability to quickly learn and adapt to new tools and technologies.


Key Responsibilities


Administrative Operations

• Prepare and manage buyer and seller documentation using the Compass platform

• Organize and maintain internal trackers, digital files, and compliance documentation using Google Drive and Compass systems

• Maintain the listing and transaction pipeline with accurate and up-to-date information

• Coordinate post-closing follow-ups, including testimonial requests


Listing & Deal Coordination

• Coordinate listing preparation, including ordering photography, signage, and related services

• Upload and manage listings across Compass, MLS, Zillow, and related platforms

• Prepare marketing materials, including social media posts, open house flyers, and email blasts

• Ensure full compliance with Compass systems and listing requirements

• Monitor and update status changes across all platforms in real time


Marketing & Lead Management

• Design and distribute e-blasts, brochures, newsletters, and social media posts using the Compass Marketing Center

• Manage the team’s Instagram and Facebook pages, supporting content creation, scheduling, and posting

• Coordinate print campaigns and seasonal marketing drops, including mail execution via Postalytics

• Support lead management and follow-ups as needed


Events & Client Support

• Present and organize vendor quotes (venues, invitations, catering, promotional items)

• Support team events and client-facing initiatives as needed

Qualifications

• Minimum 3+ years of experience in a support role such as Executive Assistant, Operations, or Marketing

• Real estate experience strongly preferred, particularly in U.S. real estate operations

• Tech-savvy, with hands-on experience using: Google Workspace, E-signature tools, CRM systems, Canva, and AI (ChatGPT)

• Strong written communication skills, with excellent grammar and clarity

• Highly detail-oriented and process-driven, with the ability to manage follow-ups, deadlines, and shifting priorities independently

• Ability to organize tasks, track progress, and proactively flag issues

• Professional, confident, and polished demeanor when interacting with clients, agents, and vendors

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, time-sensitive real estate environment

• Ability to work independently while maintaining clear, proactive communication and status updates

• Advanced English required; Spanish is a plus


Compensation & Perks

• R$4,000 per month (paid in Brazilian Reais)

• This is a remote position, compensated in BRL (R$)

• Opportunity for growth as the team and responsibilities expand

• Performance-based growth opportunities are available. Compensation and responsibilities may be reviewed based on performance, consistency, and contribution to the team.

Monday, Wednesday, Friday: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM

Tuesday and Thursday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

title: Senior Software Developer (C# / .NET)
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Software Developer with 5+ years of software development experience and a strong background in C# and .NET to join our U.S. client's engineering team. You will lead, develop, and enhance SaaS products used by thousands of customers. The right candidate is self-driven with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, who wants to make an impact on technology that reaches customers and consumers globally.

The ideal candidate has strong experience working with technical onshore, offshore, and nearshore teams along with modern cloud-based platforms, particularly within the AWS, Salesforce, Linode, and Heroku ecosystems, and is comfortable leading and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to support data-driven decision-making.

Our client provides innovative software solutions for automobile retailers, having led the market since 2014. With over 6,000 customers across North America, the company enhances the buying experience with cutting-edge software that eases communication and converts interest into purchases. Backed by private equity, the company's software features span website conversion, sales enablement, service offers management, retention marketing, and communication through the lenses of valuations, payments, inventory merchandising, and video.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of complex web applications using C# and .NET, ensuring high-quality code standards and architectural best practices
  • Mentor junior developers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable software solutions
  • Drive technical decision-making for system architecture, technology stack choices, and development processes while maintaining comprehensive documentation and testing strategies
  • Follow agile software development processes, collaborating with both onshore and offshore teams
  • Contribute to the development of cloud-based software using Node.js, React.js, TypeScript, Salesforce APEX and Lightning, PostgreSQL, AWS, MongoDB,.NET, PHP, RoR, Python, ETL/Data feeds, and Heroku
  • Continuously learn and adopt new technologies to improve product functionality

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5-10+ years of professional software development experience
  • Experience with expertise in C# and .NET
  • Experience in Salesforce Lightning and SLDS, APEX, Batch, External Client Apps (Connected App), Remote setting, Salesforce Revenue Cloud with legacy applications, and NetSuite
  • Experience in Business intelligence QuickSight developers, ETL process, and data extraction
  • Strong proficiency in database design and management (Salesforce Objects and triggers, MongoDB, SQL), RESTful API development, and cloud services integration with experience in CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience in leading software product development projects
  • Hands-on experience leading technical teams both onshore, offshore & nearshore
  • Working under limited supervision and developing code for new business features based on functional and technical specs
  • Decomposes features for a sprint team into tasks that can be accomplished within a sprint; Provides work BPLOE for tasks
  • Understands and adheres to the area's software lifecycle process
  • Communicates across and outside of the team to answer questions, resolve issues, and assess impacts on other teams of changes being made in their sprint team
  • Learns and utilizes new technologies as required, serves as an expert technical resource, advisor, and mentor in one or more feature sets or technologies supported by the development team
  • Provides technical mentorship and work task direction to a team of developers; able to fill the Technical Owner role on an agile sprint team, holding people accountable for task delivery
  • Works with product management to groom and select Features for their area to be included in upcoming releases
  • Comfortable working within a fast-paced environment
  • Self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Desired Experience

  • Knowledge of authentication systems (OAuth/OICS, OWASP security best practices, including rate limiting and data encryption
  • Familiarity with AWS services, monitoring tools, and DevOps practices, with the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues and implement effective solutions
  • Experience with DMS and CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Cox/VinSolutions, DealerSocket, DealerAccess), and VIN providers (e.g., DataOne, Polk, VinPower)
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4), Tag Manager (GTM), or Tag Assistant (GTA)
  • Knowledge of SaaS environments and SDLC methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Roadmap Release)
  • Knowledge in Business Intelligence tools, ETL, or reporting

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Professor de inglês
description:
A Town English School é uma escola especializada no ensino de idiomas para profissionais do mundo corporativo, focada em oferecer uma experiência de aprendizado diferenciada e de alta qualidade. Estamos em busca de professores de inglês qualificados para ministrar aulas online e contribuir com a criação de materiais didáticos.


O que buscamos em você:

Procuramos um profissional que compartilhe dos nossos valores, que inclua:

  • Trabalho em equipe: Colaboração constante com o time pedagógico e administrativo.
  • Boa comunicação: Capacidade de se expressar claramente e dar feedback construtivo.
  • Boa organização: Gerenciamento eficaz de turmas, atividades e prazos.
  • Adaptabilidade: Prontidão para ajustar planos de aula conforme necessário.
  • Dinamismo: Abordagem ativa e interativa em sala de aula.
  • Foco em resultados: Compromisso em acompanhar o progresso dos alunos.
  • Paixão pelo aprendizado: Estímulo ao crescimento contínuo dos alunos e de si próprios.
  • Amigável: Criação de um ambiente acolhedor e positivo para os alunos.
  • Abertura ao feedback: Capacidade de receber e seguir feedbacks da equipe pedagógica e adaptar suas aulas de acordo com as orientações da escola.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Ministrar aulas de inglês online com foco nos objetivos e necessidades dos alunos.
  • Comunicar-se regularmente com o time para alinhamento de estratégias e metodologias.
  • Corrigir atividades e fornecer feedback claro e construtivo para os alunos.
  • Participar no planejamento personalizado do aprendizado de cada aluno.
  • Preencher planilhas e manter histórico de aulas de maneira organizada e atualizada.
  • Utilizar aplicativos de gerenciamento de tarefas para controle de progresso.
  • Contribuir com a criação e adaptação de materiais didáticos quando necessário.


O que oferecemos:

  • Material didático completo e atualizado.
  • Suporte contínuo da equipe pedagógica.
  • Treinamento para aperfeiçoamento contínuo de técnicas de ensino.
  • Flexibilidade de horários para atuar remotamente.
  • Remuneração por hora-aula.
  • Valores diferenciados de hora-aula conforme o tipo de aula ou turma.
  • Bonificação baseada em desempenho e progresso dos alunos.


Carga horária:

  • Professores iniciam com uma carga horária reduzida.
  • O número de turmas aumenta progressivamente de acordo com desempenho, disponibilidade e demanda de alunos.


Requisitos para a vaga:

  • Formação completa ou em andamento em Letras, Pedagogia, Educação, ou áreas afins.
  • Inglês avançado (C1 ou C2 - CEFR).
  • Experiência prévia no ensino de inglês.
  • Afinidade com os valores da escola.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de videochamada e ferramentas tecnológicas para ensino à distância.
  • Abertura para receber feedback e ajustar práticas de ensino conforme orientações.



Diferenciais:

  • Certificações internacionais de proficiência ou ensino de inglês (Cambridge, IELTS, TOEFL, CELTA, TESOL, TEFL).
  • Experiência com Business English ou ensino de inglês para profissionais do meio corporativo.

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.

Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.

Hartwell Companies, a leader in industry innovation and a hub for top-tier talent, is on the lookout for an experienced Content Analyst to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity to make an impact in a dynamic, growth-oriented organization.


About Us: Hartwell Companies bring together strategically aligned businesses with a shared commitment to growth, innovation, and positive impact. We are a collective of dynamic enterprises, providing management experience, fresh insights, and resources to nurture each brand under our umbrella.

Location: Brazil

The primary purpose of this role is to plan, coordinate, and execute the content strategy for Hartwell companies, including SONCO Safety Marketplace.

The Content Analyst will ensure all website content is SEO-driven and aligned with Information Architecture (IA) best practices to improve search rankings, organic traffic, and user experience.

This role includes creating product descriptions for new product pages, developing content for all website pages, social media, producing customer success cases, and building alliances with organizations, associations, and LinkedIn communities to generate co-marketing initiatives.

  • Collaborate with design, video, and content writing teams to produce high-quality, SEO-driven content.
  • Plan and write customer success stories and blog posts for our website. Conduct customer interviews to gather accurate information and brief the copywriting team effectively.
  • Define and pursue alliances with organizations, associations, and LinkedIn communities for co-marketing initiatives.

  • Develop attractive, original content to attract and retain users.
  • Distribute content across channels (website, social media, email, blog).
  • Own and optimize the customer review process.
  • Support the marketing team by conducting client surveys.
  • Measure, analyze, and present results of content strategy efforts, including SEO and organic performance metrics.


Skills and Competencies required:

  • Advanced skill level in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with WordPress.

description:

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver Lightning Web Components (LWC) com arquitetura limpa, performance, consumo de dados via LDS/wire e chamadas @AuraEnabled.
  • Construir e manter integrações (REST/SOAP): callouts com Named Credentials, autenticação (OAuth/JWT), tratamento de erros e observabilidade (logs/monitoramento).
  • Atuar no ecossistema de Service Cloud & Digital Engagement (Chat, WhatsApp, Bots), integrando fluxos de atendimento e automações.
  • Realizar troubleshooting avançado (debug logs, trace flags, Event Monitoring) e otimizações de performance/consultas.
  • Versionar e implantar com SFDX + Git (branching, code review, qualidade de código).
  • Garantir segurança e compliance (FLS/CRUD, compartilhamento, transações) e produzir documentação técnica de suporte às entregas.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Forte experiência como Desenvolvedor(a) Salesforce (Pleno/Sênior) com foco em Service Cloud.

  • Vivência com Digital Engagement (Chat/Messaging/WhatsApp), incluindo implementação técnica e integração com processos de atendimento.

  • Conhecimento aprofundado de governor limits e estratégias de otimização.

  • Certificações: Platform Developer I

CLT, salário a combinar+ benefícios.

100% remoto.

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

title: Content Analyst
description:
Career Opportunity: Content Analyst at Hartwell Companies


Hartwell Companies, a leader in industry innovation and a hub for top-tier talent, is on the lookout for an experienced Content Analyst to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity to make an impact in a dynamic, growth-oriented organization.


About Us: Hartwell Companies bring together strategically aligned businesses with a shared commitment to growth, innovation, and positive impact. We are a collective of dynamic enterprises, providing management experience, fresh insights, and resources to nurture each brand under our umbrella.


Position: Content Analyst

Location: Brazil

Work Model: Contractor Remote

Working Hours: 8 AM to 5 PM EST


Job Description:

The primary purpose of this role is to plan, coordinate, and execute the content strategy for Hartwell companies, including SONCO Safety Marketplace.

The Content Analyst will ensure all website content is SEO-driven and aligned with Information Architecture (IA) best practices to improve search rankings, organic traffic, and user experience.

This role includes creating product descriptions for new product pages, developing content for all website pages, social media, producing customer success cases, and building alliances with organizations, associations, and communities to generate co-marketing initiatives.


Main Responsibilities

  • Plan, create, and distribute valuable content.
  • Lead the development and optimization of website product pages, ensuring excellent user experience and strong SEO performance.
  • Ensure website content supports the SEO strategy, including keyword targeting, internal linking, and Information Architecture improvements to enhance rankings and crawlability.
  • Collaborate with design, video, and content writing teams to produce high-quality, SEO-driven content.
  • Plan and write customer success stories and blog posts for our website. Conduct customer interviews to gather accurate information and brief the copywriting team effectively.
  • Define and pursue alliances with organizations, associations, and communities for co-marketing initiatives.
  • Review and refine digital ad content to ensure consistency and performance alignment.
  • Develop attractive, original content to attract and retain users.
  • Distribute content across channels (website, social media, email, blog).
  • Own and optimize the customer review process.
  • Support the marketing team by conducting client surveys.
  • Measure, analyze, and present results of content strategy efforts, including SEO and organic performance metrics.


Skills and Competencies required:

  • Exceptional writing and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Advanced skill level in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with WordPress.
  • Knowledge of web publishing requirements and content structuring best practices.
  • Hands-on experience with SEO and web traffic metrics.
  • Understanding of Information Architecture (IA) principles and how content structure impacts SEO and user experience.
  • Strong familiarity with various social media platforms.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to use own initiative to progress work and to work to deadlines.
  • Flexible and creative attitude toward problem-solving.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues across business units.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory, with the ability to write and interact with the US-based team.


Other details of the position:

  • Contract type: Full-time consultant.
  • Working hours: 8 hours daily (from 8 am to 5 pm EST).

title: Veterinarian
description:
About SignalPET


SignalPET is a fast-growing veterinary AI company working alongside veterinarians and radiologists to deliver faster, more accurate diagnostic support. Our mission is to enhance clinical decision-making through intelligent technology grounded in real-world veterinary medicine.


We are expanding our Medical R&D team in Brazil and are looking for a clinically strong, detail-oriented veterinarian to help build and refine the medical intelligence powering our platform.


The Role


As a Veterinarian – Medical Education & Medical Content , you will transform real SignalPET clinical cases into structured educational modules and high-quality medical marketing content.


You will help build and execute the SignalPET Training Hub & Academy , including CE-accredited learning modules, case-based training, and medical campaigns that strengthen veterinarians’ radiology skills and reinforce SignalPET’s clinical authority.


This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional role working closely with:


  • Board-certified radiologists
  • Medical R&D
  • AI and Product teams
  • Marketing


Key Responsibilities


Academy & CE Content Development


  • Develop structured, case-based learning modules using real SignalPET cases
  • Create CE-accredited courses, micro-learning sessions, pathology refreshers, and interactive quizzes
  • Build AI vs. Radiologist comparison educational insights
  • Work with specialists to validate medical accuracy
  • Manage and publish modules inside the Training Hub platform


Medical Marketing Content


  • Write clinically authoritative blogs, case spotlights, white papers, landing page content, and educational campaigns
  • Develop product-related medical materials and sales enablement tools
  • Collaborate with marketing to align messaging and positioning
  • Ensure scientific credibility through specialist validation


Workflow-Connected Learning


  • Map common clinical findings (e.g., splenic masses, thoracic disease, trauma cases) to relevant Academy modules
  • Collaborate with AI and Product teams to connect case workflows with learning opportunities


Performance & Optimization


  • Define and track CE engagement, learning participation, and content performance metrics
  • Continuously refine modules based on user feedback and clinical data


Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Participate in relevant internal meetings
  • Provide medical clarification for marketing and product initiatives
  • Coordinate with specialists and Medical R&D for content validation


Requirements


  • Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) or equivalent
  • Clinical Experience - Hands-on experience in small animal practice
  • Strong radiographic interpretation skills (canine & feline)
  • Radiology-focused experience is a plus
  • Excellent English writing skills (medical & educational content)
  • Ability to translate complex medical topics into clear, structured content
  • Experience creating CE-accredited content is a strong advantage
  • Strong small animal radiology knowledge
  • Ability to collaborate with board-certified specialists
  • Understanding of adult learning principles
  • Comfortable working in CMS and digital platforms


Working Hours


  • Monday to Friday - 7am to 4pm


*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***


This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews.


Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.


We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.



Why Join SignalPET?


  • Work at the intersection of veterinary medicine and AI
  • Impact thousands of veterinary professionals globally
  • Remote flexibility
  • Be part of a growing, mission-driven team

title: Software Engineer
description:

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect


Location: Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .



What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .
