title: Salesforce OEM Developer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $3,500 - $4,500 USD


We are seeking an experienced Salesforce OEM Developer to design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce-based products using Salesforce’s OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) platform. This role requires deep expertise in Salesforce application development, second-generation managed packages, and modern Salesforce development practices, including a thorough and practical understanding of Salesforce platform governor limits and how to design within them.


Along with our partner, we are seeking a candidate who combines strong engineering skills with deep Salesforce administrator-level knowledge to deliver secure, performant, and upgrade-safe managed solutions deployed across multiple customer orgs.


Key Responsibilities:

Salesforce OEM & Application Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Salesforce OEM solutions using second-generation managed packages (2GP)
  • Build scalable, upgrade-safe features aligned with Salesforce OEM and ISV best practices
  • Implement application logic using Apex, SOQL, and SOSL, with careful consideration of platform constraints
  • Design solutions that efficiently operate within Salesforce governor limits, including limits related to CPU time, heap size, queries, DML, and concurrent execution
  • Develop modern user experiences using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and the Lightning framework
  • Ensure package versioning, dependency management, and release processes follow Salesforce standards


Platform Configuration & Administration

  • Apply deep Salesforce admin knowledge to design effective, maintainable configurations that complement custom code
  • Build and maintain Flows (record-triggered, screen flows, orchestration), ensuring automation is performant and governor-limit aware
  • Configure and manage profiles, permission sets, permission set groups, roles, and sharing rules
  • Design and maintain page layouts, Lightning Record Pages, and UI customizations
  • Evaluate and balance declarative vs. programmatic solutions to minimize technical debt and reduce risk of governor limit violations


Source Control & DevOps

  • Use Git for source control, including branching, merging, and pull request workflows
  • Collaborate within CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce deployments (e.g., scratch orgs, packaging orgs, automated testing)
  • Support release management processes for managed packages across multiple versions and customers


Quality & Collaboration

  • Write comprehensive unit tests to ensure high code coverage and validate behavior under governor limit constraints
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex performance and limit-related issues across customer environments
  • Collaborate with product, architecture, QA, and support teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions
  • Contribute to technical documentation and Salesforce OEM best practice guidelines


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience developing on the Salesforce Platform, particularly with hands-on experience with Salesforce OEM development.
  • Proven experience building and maintaining second-generation managed packages (2GP)
  • Proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce APIs
  • Thorough understanding of Salesforce platform governor limits, including how they impact:

○Apex execution

○Flows and declarative automation

○Bulk processing and data volume

○Multi-tenant OEM applications

  • Deep Salesforce administrator-level expertise, including:

○Flow and declarative automation tooling

○Security and permissions modeling

○Page layouts and Lightning Record Pages

○Data modeling and configuration best practices

  • Experience using Git for source control in collaborative development environments
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data access patterns, and scalable design principles
  • Hold a Platform App Builder Certification is a valuable plus!


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build and scale advanced Salesforce OEM products that power multi-tenant enterprise solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: CRM Analyst - Digital Marketing
description:

We are looking for a CRM Automation Specialist to build, implement, and optimize CRM workflows, automations, pipelines, and funnel sequences for our clients.

This role is focused on turning client sales and follow-up processes into structured, functional CRM systems. We are looking for someone who is hands-on, detail-oriented, and experienced in building automations, managing lead flow, and supporting conversion-focused funnels across platforms such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Keap, or similar tools with strong pipeline and workflow automation capabilities.


Your Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain CRM workflows, automations, forms, calendars, and funnel structures
  • Set up and manage pipeline stages based on each client’s sales process, including lead follow-up, appointment booking, no-show/cancel, re-engagement, nurture, won/lost, and disqualification stages
  • Create and manage email and SMS sequences with the correct timing, wait steps, conditions, tags, and removal logic based on lead actions and funnel behavior
  • Implement appointment workflows such as confirmations, reminders, reschedule flows, and no-show recovery
  • Manage tags, custom fields, opportunity updates, internal notifications, and tasks to keep lead tracking organized and actionable
  • Review and troubleshoot workflow issues, automation conflicts, contact flow errors, and delivery problems
  • Monitor CRM and funnel performance, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements to workflow logic and follow-up structure
  • Work closely with Account Managers and internal teams to align CRM builds with client goals and campaign strategy
  • Document workflow logic and setup structure clearly for internal visibility and scalability
  • Join client calls when needed to explain CRM setups and automation logic in a clear and simple way


The Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Hands-on experience building automations and workflows in platforms such as GoHighLevel , HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Keap, or similar tools
  • Strong understanding of CRM workflows, pipelines, automations, lead nurturing, and funnel progression
  • Experience building appointment-based funnels, reminders, follow-up sequences, and re-engagement flows
  • Ability to work with tags, conditions, wait steps, opportunity movement, and lifecycle-based automations
  • Ability to troubleshoot workflow, integration, and automation issues
  • Strong organization and attention to detail
  • Advanced English

  • Agency experience

title: Mid Back-End Data Engineer (.Net / C#)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Mid Back-End Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience and strong expertise in .NET and C#. This role focuses on ingesting and transforming data from multiple sources, running data validations, and ensuring high data quality across ETL pipelines and backend services. The ideal candidate has experience with APIs, legacy data migrations, and AWS-based data environments. Experience with ECS Fargate, SQS, Kinesis, Firehose, S3, and Apache Iceberg is a plus.

This project has a 3-6 month duration with a possibility for long-term engagement.

Our client is a leading energy technology company focused on digitizing fuel operations through a single, real-time platform. Their software connects people, equipment, and facilities to provide enterprise-wide visibility and data-driven insights that fuel asset optimization, improve operational efficiency, and help organizations manage risk, maintenance, and fuel logistics more effectively.

Responsibilities


  • Receive and process raw data from multiple internal and legacy systems.
  • Design and implement data transformation pipelines that convert incoming data into standardized formats.
  • Develop and maintain .NET / C# services and APIs used for data ingestion and transformation.
  • Build and execute data validation and quality checks to ensure the reliability and accuracy of data pipelines.
  • Support ETL processes, including exporting data from legacy systems and integrating it into modern platforms.
  • Work closely with existing engineers responsible for data migration and integration efforts.
  • Act as a data quality advocate, focusing on validating and testing data flows rather than application UI or front-end functionality.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering and data teams to improve data consistency, validation processes, and pipeline stability.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering or data engineering roles.
  • Strong experience with .NET and C# development.
  • Experience developing APIs and backend services.
  • Hands-on experience with data pipelines, ETL processes, and data transformation.
  • Experience implementing data validation and data quality checks.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple systems or legacy platforms.
  • Familiarity with AWS-based data infrastructure and services.


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Python for data processing or scripting.
  • Experience working with Apache Iceberg tables for data lake management.
  • Experience with AWS data and streaming services, such as:
  • Amazon ECS Fargate
  • Amazon SQS
  • Amazon Kinesis
  • Amazon Kinesis Firehose
  • Amazon S3


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!

title: Senior Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
Senior Data Pipeline Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure that powers our platform, building integrations, transformations, and orchestration that ensure reliable, analytics-ready data for hundreds of customer workspaces.


Position Overview:


For our Client we're hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure powering our platform. You'll build integrations from marketing and sales platforms, transform raw data into analytics-ready models, and orchestrate pipelines that run reliably across hundreds of customer workspaces. This foundational role requires architectural thinking, experience with ELT patterns, columnar storage, and multi-tenant systems. If you love designing clean data models, building robust pipelines, and connecting new data sources end-to-end, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do

  • Expand our data integrations — add new source connectors (ad platforms, social media, payment processors) with full extraction, loading, transformation, and orchestration flows
  • Write and maintain incremental SQL transformation models across staging, core, and analytics layers optimized for a columnar analytics engine
  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows — event-driven sensors, schedules, partitions, and automated pipeline chains
  • Optimize our analytics warehouse — schema design, partitioning strategies, materialized views, sort keys, and data retention policies for performance at scale
  • Scale our multi-tenant architecture — each customer workspace gets isolated databases, and you'll manage the per-tenant pipeline lifecycle
  • Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and pipeline health dashboards


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering — we care about your growth trajectory, not just time served
  • Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex aggregations, and performance tuning for analytical workloads
  • Production experience with columnar analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar OLAP engines)
  • Hands-on experience with ELT pipelines and SQL transformation frameworks (dbt or similar)
  • Experience with modern data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
  • Comfortable writing data pipeline code in Python
  • Experience with cloud-based data integration platforms for managing source connectors and sync configurations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketing and ads platform APIs (TikTok, Meta, Google Ads, Pinterest)
  • Background in multi-tenant data architecture — per-customer database isolation and credential management
  • E-commerce domain knowledge — orders, customers, transactions, RFM segmentation, customer lifetime value
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and cross-database patterns between relational and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with Next.js or TypeScript — our console is built with Next.js, and wiring integrations into the frontend is a plus
  • Understanding of how data models feed into AI/LLM agent systems


Who You Are

  • You have a genuine drive to learn and grow — we hire for potential and curiosity as much as current skill
  • You think in systems — you see how extraction, transformation, orchestration, and the analytics layer fit together as one whole
  • You take ownership end-to-end — from designing the schema to monitoring the pipeline in production
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make sound architectural decisions without a playbook for every situation
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working directly with founders and cross-functional teammates


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect


Location: Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .



What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .

title: Veterinarian
description:
About SignalPET


SignalPET is a fast-growing veterinary AI company working alongside veterinarians and radiologists to deliver faster, more accurate diagnostic support. Our mission is to enhance clinical decision-making through intelligent technology grounded in real-world veterinary medicine.


We are expanding our Medical R&D team in Brazil and are looking for a clinically strong, detail-oriented veterinarian to help build and refine the medical intelligence powering our platform.


The Role


As a Veterinarian – Medical Education & Medical Content , you will transform real SignalPET clinical cases into structured educational modules and high-quality medical marketing content.


You will help build and execute the SignalPET Training Hub & Academy , including CE-accredited learning modules, case-based training, and medical campaigns that strengthen veterinarians’ radiology skills and reinforce SignalPET’s clinical authority.


This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional role working closely with:


  • Board-certified radiologists
  • Medical R&D
  • AI and Product teams
  • Marketing


Key Responsibilities


Academy & CE Content Development


  • Develop structured, case-based learning modules using real SignalPET cases
  • Create CE-accredited courses, micro-learning sessions, pathology refreshers, and interactive quizzes
  • Build AI vs. Radiologist comparison educational insights
  • Work with specialists to validate medical accuracy
  • Manage and publish modules inside the Training Hub platform


Medical Marketing Content


  • Write clinically authoritative blogs, case spotlights, white papers, landing page content, and educational campaigns
  • Develop product-related medical materials and sales enablement tools
  • Collaborate with marketing to align messaging and positioning
  • Ensure scientific credibility through specialist validation


Workflow-Connected Learning


  • Map common clinical findings (e.g., splenic masses, thoracic disease, trauma cases) to relevant Academy modules
  • Collaborate with AI and Product teams to connect case workflows with learning opportunities


Performance & Optimization


  • Define and track CE engagement, learning participation, and content performance metrics
  • Continuously refine modules based on user feedback and clinical data


Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Participate in relevant internal meetings
  • Provide medical clarification for marketing and product initiatives
  • Coordinate with specialists and Medical R&D for content validation


Requirements


  • Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) or equivalent
  • Clinical Experience - Hands-on experience in small animal practice
  • Strong radiographic interpretation skills (canine & feline)
  • Radiology-focused experience is a plus
  • Excellent English writing skills (medical & educational content)
  • Ability to translate complex medical topics into clear, structured content
  • Experience creating CE-accredited content is a strong advantage
  • Strong small animal radiology knowledge
  • Ability to collaborate with board-certified specialists
  • Understanding of adult learning principles
  • Comfortable working in CMS and digital platforms


Working Hours


  • Monday to Friday - 7am to 4pm


*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***


This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews.


Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.


We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.



Why Join SignalPET?


  • Work at the intersection of veterinary medicine and AI
  • Impact thousands of veterinary professionals globally
  • Remote flexibility
  • Be part of a growing, mission-driven team

Hartwell Companies, a leader in industry innovation and a hub for top-tier talent, is on the lookout for an experienced Content Analyst to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity to make an impact in a dynamic, growth-oriented organization.


About Us: Hartwell Companies bring together strategically aligned businesses with a shared commitment to growth, innovation, and positive impact. We are a collective of dynamic enterprises, providing management experience, fresh insights, and resources to nurture each brand under our umbrella.

Location: Brazil

Job Description:

The primary purpose of this role is to plan, coordinate, and execute the content strategy for Hartwell companies, including SONCO Safety Marketplace.

The Content Analyst will ensure all website content is SEO-driven and aligned with Information Architecture (IA) best practices to improve search rankings, organic traffic, and user experience.

This role includes creating product descriptions for new product pages, developing content for all website pages, social media, producing customer success cases, and building alliances with organizations, associations, and LinkedIn communities to generate co-marketing initiatives.

title: Estágio em Customer Success
description:
A Risposta é uma plataforma de inteligência e satisfação de clientes para restaurantes. Hoje estamos presentes em mais de 1.500 casas em todo o Brasil , incluindo grupos como Outback, Aizomê, Moma, Rascal, Origem, entre outros.

Usamos tecnologia e dados para ajudar restaurantes a oferecer experiências cada vez melhores aos seus clientes. Se você tem interesse em experiência do cliente, tecnologia e relacionamento , e quer aprender em um ambiente dinâmico, queremos te conhecer.


Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa estagiária para atuar no time de Customer Success , apoiando na jornada dos nossos clientes desde o início da utilização da plataforma.

No dia a dia, você irá:

  • Apoiar na organização e acompanhamento de onboardings de novos clientes
  • Ajudar no acompanhamento do uso da plataforma e identificar possíveis dúvidas ou dificuldades
  • Auxiliar na preparação e condução de treinamentos e apresentações remotas
  • Realizar follow-ups e comunicações de engajamento com clientes
  • Contribuir com o registro de feedbacks e aprendizados dos clientes para os times internos
  • Apoiar na organização de informações e acompanhamento de contas


O que buscamos
  • Estar cursando graduação em áreas como Administração, Comunicação, Marketing, Relações Internacionais, Economia ou áreas correlatas
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes
  • Interesse em experiência do cliente, tecnologia e relacionamento com clientes
  • Proatividade e vontade de aprender



Diferenciais
  • Interesse em negócios B2B ou tecnologia
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de organização ou CRM
  • Interesse por hospitalidade, gastronomia e comportamento do consumidor


O que você encontra na Risposta
  • Ambiente colaborativo e aberto à troca de ideias
  • Contato próximo com diferentes áreas da empresa
  • Aprendizado prático sobre Customer Success e relacionamento com clientes
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver habilidades em um setor que cresce cada vez mais

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Position Summary:

We are seeking friendly and motivated Customer Support Specialists to serve our

customers and restaurant owners by providing assistance regarding account management

or order inquiries. This could include changes to their account, minor updates to their

menu, or inquiries about an order


Essential Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Take inbound calls from either the customer or the restaurant.
  • Make outbound calls to customers or restaurants to follow up on acknowledgement errors.
  • Manage incoming tickets generated from email or text via CRM (customer relationship management portal).
  • Return calls for any voicemails that a ticket is generated for Minor troubleshooting product or service problems reported by the customer or the restaurant.

  • Facilitate and document accurate correspondence between the restaurant and customers
  • Miscellaneous clerical duties.


Education:

  • Minimum – High school diploma (or Equivalent)


Experience:

  • 6+ months work experience (Internship acceptable)
  • Fluent in English - Bilingual Spanish/English preferred
  • Must be available for evening and weekend shifts
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong critical thinking / problem solving skills
  • Preferred but not required:
  • Previous call center experience
  • Food Industry experience


What You Need For This Position:

  • Be flexible with working schedules, including nights and weekends
  • Efficient in operating a computer in a Windows based environment
  • Possess strong verbal and written communication skills in the English language
  • Communicate effectively in the English language
  • Have strong interpersonal skills, problem solving skills and negotiating skills
  • Think analytically
  • Work in a fast-paced environment
  • Be organized and have strong time management skills

title: Senior Front-end Developer (React.js) - Project
description:
We are looking for a remote, skilled Senior Front-End Engineer with 5+ years of experience in React.js to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for shaping ideas and user feedback into delightful experiences, developing and implementing user interface components into the latest React.js concepts and workflows, and leading the engineering efforts for user-facing features. You will work with our product and user experience teams to deliver end-to-end features that deliver business value that users love.


This project has a 6-month duration with a possibility for long-term engagement.


Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform allows companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the User Experience and Product teams to create end-to-end designs for new features
  • Take ownership of product features from design, implementation, and delivery, to post-delivery feedback and follow-up work
  • Coordinate development efforts across team members and ensure successful delivery
  • Architect, develop, and implement highly-responsive user interface components using JavaScript and React.js
  • Provide technical leadership to teammates through coaching and mentorship
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, and help find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience as a front-end engineer writing single-page applications that communicate with API back-ends, and knowledge of JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A well-developed understanding of frontend concepts and various frameworks
  • A focus on delivering value to customers
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what your customers and team members need to be successful
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentlessness in pursuing goals and solving problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field
  • Node.js and Python experience
  • Additional Information
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays annually
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

  • The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger


The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

  • We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Community Manager
description:

Falamos de esportes e apostas com uma linguagem leve, criativa e próxima do público brasileiro, sem abrir mão de informação, contexto e responsabilidade editorial. Procuramos alguém que saiba equilibrar resenha, timing e leitura de comunidade.


Devido à natureza do calendário esportivo, e em particular para a cobertura da Copa do Mundo durante o período da contratação, é desejável flexibilidade de horário para cobrir online os jogos que serão transmitidos da América do Norte (Canadá, EUA e México).


Se você se identifica com esse ambiente, gosta de futebol para além do placar e entende o valor de construir comunidade — queremos conhecer você.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Criar e publicar conteúdos diários para Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok e outras redes;
  • Monitorar menções e interagir com o público de forma criativa e respeitosa;
  • Estar atento(a) a trends, memes e momentos do futebol para gerar engajamento;
  • Colaborar com o time editorial para alinhar prognósticos, posts e campanhas;
  • Criar e redigir e-mails de marketing para a base de usuários do Apostas no IG ou em conjunto com os outros projetos e sites do grupo.
  • Acompanhar métricas e propor novas estratégias para aumentar o alcance.
  • Realizar a cobertura online da Copa do Mundo durante o período da contratação, incluindo interações e posts em tempo real sobre os jogos transmitidos da América do Norte (Canadá, EUA e México).


Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia com social media ou community management;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas gráficas (Adobe photoshop,Illustrator etc) e edição de vídeo (Capcut,Riverside, After Effects etc);
  • Fluência em português brasileiro (conteúdo voltado para o público do Brasil);
  • Paixão por esportes, especialmente futebol;
  • Escrita criativa e ágil, com domínio de linguagem digital;
  • Organização para lidar com demandas rápidas e calendário editorial;
  • Noções de métricas e ferramentas de gerenciamento de redes sociais e CRM (Hubspot, RD Station, Optimove etc);
  • Disponibilidade e flexibilidade de horário para cobrir eventos e jogos online, em especial durante a Copa do Mundo.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência na gestão de perfis de humor ou entretenimento esportivo;
  • Habilidade para criar memes, reels ou vídeos curtos;
  • Conhecimento de SEO e tendências do universo esportivo online.

Híbrido para quem morar em Porto, Portugal. Remoto para demais localidades.

title: Professor de inglês online
description:
A DevSpeak Academy é uma escola especializada no ensino de inglês para profissionais da área de tecnologia. Nosso foco é preparar alunos para se comunicarem com confiança no mercado internacional, em turmas pequenas e com aulas totalmente online.

Estamos em busca de professores(as) de inglês para integrar nosso time! Procuramos profissionais engajados, comunicativos e que saibam se conectar com adultos que trabalham em TI, trazendo para as aulas situações práticas e relevantes para o dia a dia desses alunos.


Responsabilidades

  • Preparar e ministrar aulas online para adultos, focando em fluência e comunicação em contextos profissionais.
  • Personalizar o conteúdo conforme as necessidades dos alunos, com foco em temas ligados à área de tecnologia.
  • Preencher e manter atualizadas as planilhas de presença e conteúdos ministrados.
  • Disponibilizar semanalmente os materiais e gravações no Google Classroom, seguindo a metodologia da escola.
  • Incentivar a participação e engajamento dos alunos, criando um ambiente colaborativo e motivador.
  • Participar de treinamentos e reuniões pedagógicas para melhoria contínua.


Requisitos

  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.
  • Experiência como professor(a) de inglês.
  • Disponibilidade no período da noite (18h–22h), duas vezes por semana (segunda/quarta ou terça/quinta).
  • Perfil comunicativo e afinidade para trabalhar com profissionais da área de TI.
  • Organização e comprometimento com prazos.
  • Possuir computador para ministrar as aulas.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Disponibilidade no período da manhã (7h-9h), duas vezes por semana (segunda/quarta ou terça/quinta).
  • Conhecimento em Google Meet e Google Classroom.
  • Experiência com ensino para profissionais de TI.
  • Certificações em ensino de inglês (TEFL, CELTA ou equivalentes).


Contratação

  • Regime PJ .

The Machine Learning and Data Science Specialist position focuses on serving as the owner of ML algorithms powering campaign segmentation and targeting systems. title: Mid Back-End Data Engineer (.Net / C#)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Mid Back-End Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience and strong expertise in .NET and C#. This role focuses on ingesting and transforming data from multiple sources, running data validations, and ensuring high data quality across ETL pipelines and backend services. The ideal candidate has experience with APIs, legacy data migrations, and AWS-based data environments. Experience with ECS Fargate, SQS, Kinesis, Firehose, S3, and Apache Iceberg is a plus.

This project has a 3-6 month duration with a possibility for long-term engagement.

Our client is a leading energy technology company focused on digitizing fuel operations through a single, real-time platform. Their software connects people, equipment, and facilities to provide enterprise-wide visibility and data-driven insights that fuel asset optimization, improve operational efficiency, and help organizations manage risk, maintenance, and fuel logistics more effectively.

Responsibilities


  • Receive and process raw data from multiple internal and legacy systems.
  • Design and implement data transformation pipelines that convert incoming data into standardized formats.
  • Develop and maintain .NET / C# services and APIs used for data ingestion and transformation.
  • Build and execute data validation and quality checks to ensure the reliability and accuracy of data pipelines.
  • Support ETL processes, including exporting data from legacy systems and integrating it into modern platforms.
  • Work closely with existing engineers responsible for data migration and integration efforts.
  • Act as a data quality advocate, focusing on validating and testing data flows rather than application UI or front-end functionality.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering and data teams to improve data consistency, validation processes, and pipeline stability.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering or data engineering roles.
  • Strong experience with .NET and C# development.
  • Experience developing APIs and backend services.
  • Hands-on experience with data pipelines, ETL processes, and data transformation.
  • Experience implementing data validation and data quality checks.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple systems or legacy platforms.
  • Familiarity with AWS-based data infrastructure and services.


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Python for data processing or scripting.
  • Experience working with Apache Iceberg tables for data lake management.
  • Experience with AWS data and streaming services, such as:
  • Amazon ECS Fargate

title: Salesforce OEM Developer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $3,500 - $4,500 USD


We are seeking an experienced Salesforce OEM Developer to design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce-based products using Salesforce’s OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) platform. This role requires deep expertise in Salesforce application development, second-generation managed packages, and modern Salesforce development practices, including a thorough and practical understanding of Salesforce platform governor limits and how to design within them.


Along with our partner, we are seeking a candidate who combines strong engineering skills with deep Salesforce administrator-level knowledge to deliver secure, performant, and upgrade-safe managed solutions deployed across multiple customer orgs.


Key Responsibilities:

Salesforce OEM & Application Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Salesforce OEM solutions using second-generation managed packages (2GP)
  • Build scalable, upgrade-safe features aligned with Salesforce OEM and ISV best practices
  • Implement application logic using Apex, SOQL, and SOSL, with careful consideration of platform constraints
  • Design solutions that efficiently operate within Salesforce governor limits, including limits related to CPU time, heap size, queries, DML, and concurrent execution
  • Develop modern user experiences using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and the Lightning framework
  • Ensure package versioning, dependency management, and release processes follow Salesforce standards


Platform Configuration & Administration

  • Apply deep Salesforce admin knowledge to design effective, maintainable configurations that complement custom code
  • Build and maintain Flows (record-triggered, screen flows, orchestration), ensuring automation is performant and governor-limit aware
  • Configure and manage profiles, permission sets, permission set groups, roles, and sharing rules
  • Design and maintain page layouts, Lightning Record Pages, and UI customizations
  • Evaluate and balance declarative vs. programmatic solutions to minimize technical debt and reduce risk of governor limit violations


Source Control & DevOps

  • Use Git for source control, including branching, merging, and pull request workflows
  • Collaborate within CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce deployments (e.g., scratch orgs, packaging orgs, automated testing)
  • Support release management processes for managed packages across multiple versions and customers


Quality & Collaboration

  • Write comprehensive unit tests to ensure high code coverage and validate behavior under governor limit constraints
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex performance and limit-related issues across customer environments
  • Collaborate with product, architecture, QA, and support teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions
  • Contribute to technical documentation and Salesforce OEM best practice guidelines


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience developing on the Salesforce Platform, particularly with hands-on experience with Salesforce OEM development.
  • Proven experience building and maintaining second-generation managed packages (2GP)
  • Proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce APIs
  • Thorough understanding of Salesforce platform governor limits, including how they impact:

○Apex execution

○Flows and declarative automation

○Bulk processing and data volume

○Multi-tenant OEM applications

  • Deep Salesforce administrator-level expertise, including:

○Flow and declarative automation tooling

○Security and permissions modeling

○Page layouts and Lightning Record Pages

○Data modeling and configuration best practices

  • Experience using Git for source control in collaborative development environments
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data access patterns, and scalable design principles
  • Hold a Platform App Builder Certification is a valuable plus!


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build and scale advanced Salesforce OEM products that power multi-tenant enterprise solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‑on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‑to‑end reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making; ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‑to‑end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services; monitor performance and iterate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‑on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.g., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).
  • Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.


Tech Stack (Indicative)

  • Languages: Java, Python, C++
  • Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding
  • Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization
  • Frontend: Component‑based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows)
  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E; CI/CD pipelines
  • Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuning


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong problem‑solving skills and a data‑driven mindset.
  • Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs.
  • Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Excellent collaboration with cross‑functional partners and stakeholders.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

  • Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

Role Details

We are looking for a talented senior data engineer specializing in building a highly scalable cloudbased GraphQL API layer to deliver sports and betting data across multiple digital platforms. This role involves creating a seamless and efficient data ingestion processing and delivery system integrating streaming data and highperformance querying.


You’ll work closely with crossfunctional teams to design and implement a federated GraphQL architecture driving the future of sports and betting data integration within the CBS Sports digital ecosystem.


Your Day-to-Day

  • Build new foundational capabilities using domain-driven design and test-driven development that will power features and experiences on various CBS Sports properties
  • Help lead team members in the design development and optimization of our core sports GraphQL subgraphs and services within a federated architecture
  • Participate in scrum ceremonies daily standups grooming and sprint planning
  • Practice DevOps writing good tests and deploying continuously to production with observability and monitoring
  • Review your teammates designs and code providing constructive feedback and engaging in technical discussions including weekly deep dive sessions on various topics
  • Work with product partners to develop technical solutions for features leveraging GraphQL for data integration


Key Projects

  • Building out a GraphQL API for seamless data access and integration across multiple services
  • Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products ingesting processing and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores

title: Senior Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
Senior Data Pipeline Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure that powers our platform, building integrations, transformations, and orchestration that ensure reliable, analytics-ready data for hundreds of customer workspaces.


Position Overview:


For our Client we're hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure powering our platform. You'll build integrations from marketing and sales platforms, transform raw data into analytics-ready models, and orchestrate pipelines that run reliably across hundreds of customer workspaces. This foundational role requires architectural thinking, experience with ELT patterns, columnar storage, and multi-tenant systems. If you love designing clean data models, building robust pipelines, and connecting new data sources end-to-end, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do

  • Expand our data integrations — add new source connectors (ad platforms, social media, payment processors) with full extraction, loading, transformation, and orchestration flows
  • Write and maintain incremental SQL transformation models across staging, core, and analytics layers optimized for a columnar analytics engine
  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows — event-driven sensors, schedules, partitions, and automated pipeline chains
  • Optimize our analytics warehouse — schema design, partitioning strategies, materialized views, sort keys, and data retention policies for performance at scale
  • Scale our multi-tenant architecture — each customer workspace gets isolated databases, and you'll manage the per-tenant pipeline lifecycle
  • Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and pipeline health dashboards


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering — we care about your growth trajectory, not just time served
  • Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex aggregations, and performance tuning for analytical workloads
  • Production experience with columnar analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar OLAP engines)
  • Hands-on experience with ELT pipelines and SQL transformation frameworks (dbt or similar)
  • Experience with modern data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
  • Comfortable writing data pipeline code in Python
  • Experience with cloud-based data integration platforms for managing source connectors and sync configurations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketing and ads platform APIs (TikTok, Meta, Google Ads, Pinterest)
  • Background in multi-tenant data architecture — per-customer database isolation and credential management
  • E-commerce domain knowledge — orders, customers, transactions, RFM segmentation, customer lifetime value
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and cross-database patterns between relational and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with Next.js or TypeScript — our console is built with Next.js, and wiring integrations into the frontend is a plus
  • Understanding of how data models feed into AI/LLM agent systems


Who You Are

  • You have a genuine drive to learn and grow — we hire for potential and curiosity as much as current skill
  • You think in systems — you see how extraction, transformation, orchestration, and the analytics layer fit together as one whole
  • You take ownership end-to-end — from designing the schema to monitoring the pipeline in production
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make sound architectural decisions without a playbook for every situation
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working directly with founders and cross-functional teammates


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Ventilação Sênior
description:
Engenheiro(a) de Ventilação Sênior


Local: Fazenda Brasileiro – Teofilândia (BA), Brasil

Quantidade de Vagas: 01

Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial

Disponibilidade: Mudança para a região (empresa oferece suporte)


Sobre a Oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Ventilação Sênior para atuar na mina subterrânea , sendo responsável pelo planejamento estratégico e gestão do sistema de ventilação , bem como pelo acompanhamento de sua execução junto à equipe de Infraestrutura, assegurando condições adequadas de qualidade do ar, segurança operacional, conformidade legal e suporte eficiente às atividades de lavra e desenvolvimento da mina.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Definir a estratégia de ventilação da mina subterrânea, garantindo alinhamento ao plano de negócios, à segurança dos trabalhadores e à sustentabilidade da operação;
  • Desenvolver e revisar projetos de ventilação para mina subterrânea (primária e secundária);
  • Realizar estudos de fluxo de ar, controle de gases, poeiras, temperatura e umidade;
  • Dimensionar ventiladores principais e auxiliares, dutos, portas e reguladores de ventilação;
  • Elaborar e manter atualizados os planos de ventilação da mina;
  • Propor e implementar inovações, melhorias tecnológicas e iniciativas de otimização de custos nos sistemas de ventilação, visando ganhos de produtividade, segurança e sustentabilidade;
  • Analisar riscos críticos relacionados à ventilação, gases, particulados e condições ambientais, apoiando a gestão de riscos operacionais e a tomada de decisão estratégica;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com geologia, planejamento de mina, produção, manutenção e SSMA;
  • Liderar estudos avançados de ventilação e projetos associados à expansão, aprofundamento ou mudanças de layout da mina, viabilizando tecnicamente novos cenários operacionais com segurança e eficiência.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação Completa em Engenharia;
  • Experiência sólida em ventilação de minas subterrâneas;
  • Vivência com softwares de ventilação (ex.: Ventsim, VentSim Design, VUMA ou similares);
  • Disponibilidade de mudança para Teofilândia, BA;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Ventilação de Minas, Segurança do Trabalho (desejável).


Se você tem interesse em ventilação de mina subterrânea, planejamento e controle da qualidade do ar, atuação em campo e liderança de equipes em um ambiente operacional dinâmico, essa vaga pode ser para você!

title: Web Designer
description:
About the company:

Our client is a digital-focused organization that provides creative branding and online presence solutions. They specialize in helping businesses elevate their identity and build high-performing websites across modern platforms.


Job Description:

Our client is seeking a full-time Web Designer with strong branding capabilities. The ideal candidate excels in creating visually compelling brand identities and translating them into clean, functional, and modern website designs. Experience designing for platforms such as Webflow, Shopify, or similar CMS/eCommerce tools is highly valued.


Responsibilities of the role:

• Develop high-quality, user-centric website designs aligned with brand guidelines.

• Create and refine brand visuals, including color palettes, typography, and style systems.

• Collaborate with clients or internal teams to understand project goals and brand direction.

• Design responsive layouts optimized for various devices.

• Work with Webflow, Shopify, or other platforms to ensure design feasibility and proper handoff.

• Maintain consistent brand identity across all digital materials.

• Provide creative input and propose design improvements as needed.


Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Proven experience in website design and branding.

• Strong portfolio showcasing brand development and modern website design projects.

• Experience designing for Webflow, Shopify, or similar platforms.

• Proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, Illustrator, or equivalent.

• Understanding of UI/UX best practices and responsive design principles.

• Ability to translate abstract ideas into clear, aesthetic visual concepts.


Preferred Skills:

• Familiarity with front-end fundamentals (HTML/CSS) for better design-to-dev collaboration.

• Experience with creating design systems.

• Knowledge of eCommerce design best practices.

• Ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, project-driven environments.


Personality:

• Highly creative with a strong eye for detail.

• Proactive and able to work independently.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to receive and integrate feedback.

• Organized, reliable, and deadline-oriented.


Software & Tools

• Figma

• Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, XD)

• Webflow / Shopify (design-focused use)

• Additional design or prototyping tools as needed


English Level:

C2, Native, C1


Schedule:

9-5 EST

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer


About the Role

This role is focused on backend development, specifically supporting the migration of our customer support platform from Zendesk to Gladly, as well as maintaining and extending the integration services that power our support operations.

You'll be embedded in a small, collaborative engineering team working directly with Customer Support and Ticketing Platform teams. If you thrive in fast-moving environments, take pride in owning your code end-to-end, and enjoy meaningful technical work — this role is for you.


What You'll Be Working On:

  • Lead and contribute to the ongoing migration of our customer support system from Zendesk to Gladly, with a go-live planned.
  • Develop and maintain backend services and integration layers within our Ruby on Rails monolith
  • Build and support internal integration services that connect our support platforms with core business systems
  • Participate in sprint ceremonies, code reviews, and collaborative planning sessions
  • Own the quality of your work — writing tests, performing developer-driven QA, and ensuring production readiness without a dedicated QA engineer
  • Collaborate closely with Customer Support Representative (CSR) teams and ticketing platform stakeholders


Tech Stack:

  • Primary: Ruby, Ruby on Rails
  • Architecture: Rails monolith + separate integration services
  • Supporting: REST APIs, JSON, internal tooling


What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong Ruby development skills are a must
  • Solid experience building and maintaining backend services and API integrations
  • Comfort working without a dedicated QA team you own testing and production readiness
  • Experience working in Agile environments (sprints, code reviews, ceremonies)
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with Gladly and/or Zendesk
  • Background in platform migrations
  • Full-stack exposure (React, TypeScript, HTML/CSS) beneficial for potential future team movement
  • Familiarity with GraphQL or Kafka

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills

title: Gerente de Projetos de Infraestrutura e Segurança #992612
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Detalhes do Projeto

Consultor Funcional SAP MM com forte capacidade analítica e conhecimento de processos de suprimentos e gestão de materiais. Será responsável pelo mapeamento funcional de dados oriundos de transações Standard e Z (aproximadamente 70 transações), fornecendo direcionamento estruturado ao time ABAP para desenvolvimento de extratores e disponibilização das informações para fins analíticos e integrações.


Detalhes do projeto :

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Projetos Pleno com experiência em Infraestrutura de TI e Segurança da Informação, para atuar em regime 100% remoto. O(a) profissional será responsável pela governança de fornecedores, acompanhamento de projetos simultâneos e consolidação de relatórios estratégicos para a diretoria.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

- Elaboração de relatórios executivos que apontam vulnerabilidades identificadas em sistemas, aplicações, nuvem e desenvolvimentos internos.

- Análise de riscos de exposição e consolidação das falhas encontradas, destacando impacto e urgência.

- Acompanhamento das correções junto aos responsáveis pelas aplicações e infraestrutura, cobrando prazos e garantindo execução das ações necessárias.

- Governança de fornecedores: monitorar contratos, SLAs e reuniões periódicas para assegurar cumprimento das entregas.

- Apresentação quinzenal de reports para a diretoria, com status das vulnerabilidades, riscos e andamento das correções.

- Gestão de múltiplos projetos simultâneos (3 a 5 em média), equilibrando governança de segurança e infraestrutura.

- Suporte aos projetos conduzidos por terceiros, garantindo alinhamento com processos internos e prazos definidos.

- Controle financeiro e de terceiros envolvidos nos projetos, assegurando conformidade e eficiência.

- Aplicação de metodologias ágeis (SCRUM/PMI) para organizar e acompanhar atividades de segurança e infraestrutura.


Experiência :

- Experiência em gerenciamento de projetos de infraestrutura e segurança.

- Vivência em governança de fornecedores, contratos e acompanhamento de SLAs.

- Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (SCRUM, PMI).

- Experiência em elaboração de relatórios executivos sobre vulnerabilidades e riscos.

- Capacidade de acompanhar e cobrar correções de falhas em sistemas, aplicações e nuvem.

- Conhecimento técnico em ambientes de:

- Azure

- AWS

- Active Directory (AD)

- SIEM

- Firewall

- CNAP

- CSPM


Diferenciais

- Graduação ou experiência prévia em Segurança da Informação.

- Experiência em projetos de infraestrutura de TI voltados para segurança.

- Habilidade em comunicação assertiva

title: Professor de inglês
description:
A Town English School é uma escola especializada no ensino de idiomas para profissionais do mundo corporativo, focada em oferecer uma experiência de aprendizado diferenciada e de alta qualidade. Estamos em busca de professores de inglês qualificados para ministrar aulas online e contribuir com a criação de materiais didáticos.


O que buscamos em você:

Procuramos um profissional que compartilhe dos nossos valores, que inclua:

  • Trabalho em equipe: Colaboração constante com o time pedagógico e administrativo.
  • Boa comunicação: Capacidade de se expressar claramente e dar feedback construtivo.
  • Boa organização: Gerenciamento eficaz de turmas, atividades e prazos.
  • Adaptabilidade: Prontidão para ajustar planos de aula conforme necessário.
  • Dinamismo: Abordagem ativa e interativa em sala de aula.
  • Foco em resultados: Compromisso em acompanhar o progresso dos alunos.
  • Paixão pelo aprendizado: Estímulo ao crescimento contínuo dos alunos e de si próprios.
  • Amigável: Criação de um ambiente acolhedor e positivo para os alunos.
  • Abertura ao feedback: Capacidade de receber e seguir feedbacks da equipe pedagógica e adaptar suas aulas de acordo com as orientações da escola.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Ministrar aulas de inglês online com foco nos objetivos e necessidades dos alunos.
  • Comunicar-se regularmente com o time para alinhamento de estratégias e metodologias.
  • Corrigir atividades e fornecer feedback claro e construtivo para os alunos.
  • Participar no planejamento personalizado do aprendizado de cada aluno.
  • Preencher planilhas e manter histórico de aulas de maneira organizada e atualizada.
  • Utilizar aplicativos de gerenciamento de tarefas para controle de progresso.
  • Contribuir com a criação e adaptação de materiais didáticos quando necessário.


O que oferecemos:

  • Material didático completo e atualizado.
  • Suporte contínuo da equipe pedagógica.
  • Treinamento para aperfeiçoamento contínuo de técnicas de ensino.
  • Flexibilidade de horários para atuar remotamente.
  • Remuneração por hora-aula.
  • Valores diferenciados de hora-aula conforme o tipo de aula ou turma.
  • Bonificação baseada em desempenho e progresso dos alunos.


Carga horária:

  • Professores iniciam com uma carga horária reduzida.
  • O número de turmas aumenta progressivamente de acordo com desempenho, disponibilidade e demanda de alunos.


Requisitos para a vaga:

  • Formação completa ou em andamento em Letras, Pedagogia, Educação, ou áreas afins.
  • Inglês avançado (C1 ou C2 - CEFR).
  • Experiência prévia no ensino de inglês.
  • Afinidade com os valores da escola.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de videochamada e ferramentas tecnológicas para ensino à distância.
  • Abertura para receber feedback e ajustar práticas de ensino conforme orientações.



Diferenciais:

  • Certificações internacionais de proficiência ou ensino de inglês (Cambridge, IELTS, TOEFL, CELTA, TESOL, TEFL).
  • Experiência com Business English ou ensino de inglês para profissionais do meio corporativo.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) IOS Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) iOS para atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicativos mobile para o ecossistema Apple. Essa pessoa será responsável por construir novas funcionalidades, evoluir a arquitetura das aplicações e garantir qualidade, performance e escalabilidade do código .


Buscamos alguém com boa autonomia técnica, atenção à qualidade do código e que goste de colaborar com times multidisciplinares.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Desenvolver e manter aplicativos iOS utilizando Swift
  • Escrever código limpo, organizado e de fácil manutenção
  • Traduzir protótipos e designs em interfaces funcionais e bem estruturadas
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com designers, desenvolvedores backend e outros membros do time
  • Participar de discussões técnicas e contribuir para evolução da arquitetura das aplicações
  • Identificar e corrigir bugs e problemas de performance
  • Realizar integração com APIs e serviços backend
  • Acompanhar tendências e boas práticas do ecossistema iOS


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Domínio da linguagem Swift
  • Domínio de Programação Orientada a Objetos (POO)
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de interfaces utilizando Auto Layout e Interface Builder (Storyboards e XIBs)
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura MVVM
  • Familiaridade com design patterns como Delegate, Notification e Injeção de Dependências
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de dependências utilizando CocoaPods
  • Conhecimento dos frameworks nativos da Apple e das Human Interface Guidelines
  • Experiência no consumo de APIs RESTful e manipulação de JSON
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git (Gitflow)
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Experiência com publicação e gerenciamento de aplicativos na App Store
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de software mobile
  • Experiência com automação de testes para aplicações mobile
  • Experiência com Firebase
  • Experiência com integração com APIs e SDKs nativos do iOS


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Bolsista Doutor - Algemas Brasil - Produção e Produtividade | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .


Sobre a Oportunidade:


Impulsionar a produtividade e elevar a eficiência operacional é o que move a Algemas Brasil Indústria, Comércio e Monitoramento de Sistemas, e você pode fazer parte dessa evolução. Estamos em busca de talentos com visão analítica, capacidade estratégica e foco em resultados para atuar em um projeto voltado ao aprimoramento dos processos produtivos e logísticos da empresa.

Esta oportunidade envolve o desenvolvimento e aplicação de ferramentas avançadas de PCP, integração com sistemas de chão de fábrica, análise de capacidade e eficiência operacional, além do mapeamento e melhoria contínua do fluxo produtivo. O objetivo é tornar a operação mais inteligente, ágil e integrada, contribuindo diretamente para o aumento da produtividade.

Se você deseja aplicar seus conhecimentos em um ambiente dinâmico, desafiador e orientado à performance, com foco em otimização, tecnologia e impacto real nos resultados industriais, esta oportunidade é para você.

Logística ou Engenharia de Produção.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Produção e Produtividade

Conhecimento necessário:

Conhecimento desejável:
